points.description: States that the burned-out bulb is the one where the multimeter reads a non-zero (full/battery-level) voltage across its two terminals, while working bulbs read approximately zero.

rubric.notes: Full mark for identifying the bulb that shows a non-zero voltage reading across its two terminals (equivalent wording accepted). No marks for answers that don't refer to a voltage reading or that say a zero reading marks the bad bulb.
